Jill / Neha —

I pulled numbers from the token model and ran a conservative / baseline / optimistic scenario to address Jill’s asks. High-level:
- Baseline (our recommended planning case): median prompt 420, batching factor 1.6x, cache hit 12% => estimated monthly cost $23,400 for month 1 volume (1,600 DAU).
- Conservative (no cache, minimal batching 1.1x): estimated monthly cost $41,700 (this is the 95th percentile scenario Jill asked for).
- Optimistic (higher batching 1.9x, cache hit 20%): $16,800 / month.

Notes on sensitivity:
- Each 5% absolute change in cache hit rate moves monthly cost ~6% (non-linear because cached requests are shorter).
- Batching window increases improve throughput but may add +40–120ms median latency depending on model and region. We can model specific UX windows if the product team gives target P50/P95 tradeoffs.
